title: test_aead.rs: AES-GCM/CCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, XChaCha20-Poly1305 via aead traits
description:
Write tests/test_aead.rs: test aead::AeadInPlace impls for AES-128/256-GCM, AES-128/256-CCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, XChaCha20-Poly1305 against Wycheproof JSON.

## What
Verify AEAD wrappers correctly seal/open and reject tampered ciphertexts using all Wycheproof valid+invalid test cases.

## Algorithm
1. For each algorithm, call common::load_wycheproof_json(path) for:
   - external/wycheproof/testvectors_v1/aes_gcm_test.json
   - external/wycheproof/testvectors_v1/aes_ccm_test.json
   - external/wycheproof/testvectors_v1/chacha20_poly1305_test.json
   - external/wycheproof/testvectors_v1/xchacha20_poly1305_test.json
2. For each test group in JSON: filter by tagSize==128 (16 bytes). For GCM/CCM filter key_size 128 and 256.
3. For valid cases (result=='valid'):
   a. use aead::KeyInit; let cipher = Aes128Gcm::new_from_slice(key).unwrap();
   b. let mut buf = pt.to_vec(); let tag = cipher.encrypt_in_place_detached(nonce.into(), aad, &mut buf).unwrap();
   c. assert_eq!(buf, expected_ct); assert_eq!(tag.as_slice(), expected_tag);
4. For invalid cases (result=='invalid'):
   a. let mut buf = ct.to_vec();
   b. assert!(cipher.decrypt_in_place_detached(nonce.into(), aad, &mut buf, tag.into()).is_err());
5. Skip/document AES-192-GCM and AES-192-CCM with #[ignore] and a comment explaining the gap.
6. Nonce size filtering: GCM uses 12-byte nonce (filter ivSize==96); CCM may vary.
7. Compile-time check: fn _aead<A: aead::AeadInPlace>() {} for each type.

## Defensive rules
- Filter out Wycheproof groups with unsupported nonce/tag sizes rather than panicking; log skipped group counts
- Never test using decrypt-then-check-ciphertext (always use the AEAD tag)
- On invalid cases, ensure buffer is zeroed or discarded after failed decrypt to prevent plaintext oracle
- assert that nonce type is correct size at compile time (12 bytes for GCM)

## Agent team
- Agent R: inspect wycheproof aes_gcm_test.json schema (fields: key, iv, aad, msg, ct, tag, result, flags) and verify nonce field name is 'iv' not 'nonce'
- Agent I: write test_aead.rs per algorithm above
- Agent T: manually pick 2 Wycheproof GCM vectors and derive expected output independently; verify they appear in the JSON file

## Tests (oracles)
- Wycheproof testvectors_v1/aes_gcm_test.json (all valid+invalid cases with 128-bit tag, 96-bit nonce)
- Wycheproof testvectors_v1/chacha20_poly1305_test.json
- Missing Aes192Gcm documented with #[ignore] annotation
